_readme: The settings the founders will choose on pump.fun's create form, written down before the coin exists. The time of the commit that merges this file is the pre-registration: node scripts/audit.mjs --ouverture reads the coin back against it. A value here is a setting, never an address: the creator is the wallets.creator of public/live.json (an address given with --creator at the time of the read is NOT pre-registered, and the ticket says so), and the launch reserves are the ones in pump.fun's Global account at the moment of the read. Sources: docs/moteur.md section 3 and docs/lancement.md, the creation settings. The audit refuses a file that declares anything else than these settings, so a changed value is a change of the plan: it goes through a pull request both founders approve.
